data.current_description:
The Events API provides event push as well as historical queries via SSE (server sent events).

You can listen to events related to trade updates. Most market trades sent during market hours are filled instantly; you can listen to limit order updates through this endpoint.

Historical events are streamed immediately if queried, and updates are pushed as events occur.

Query Params Rules:
- `since` required if `until` specified
- `since_id` required if `until_id` specified
- `since` and `since_id` can't be used at the same time
Behavior:
- if `since` or `since_id` not specified this will not return any historic data
- if `until` or `until_id` reached stream will end (status 200)
data.summary_suggestion: Stream real-time and historical trade order events
data.description_suggestion: Establishes a server-sent events (SSE) stream to receive real-time trade order updates including fills, partial fills, cancellations, and rejections. Supports querying historical events by specifying `since`/`since_id` and `until`/`until_id` parameters. Returns a continuous stream of trade event objects with event types such as 'fill', 'partial_fill', 'canceled', 'rejected', 'accepted', 'pending_new', 'new', 'expired', 'done_for_day', and 'replaced'. Without `since` or `since_id`, only real-time events are streamed. Stream terminates with HTTP 200 when `until` or `until_id` is reached. Note: Generated clients may hang if neither `since`/`until` nor `since_id`/`until_id` are specified.
